summary:
Root owns complete recovery and Home/Root/stage integration joins while component contributions retain disjoint touch-sets; Home retains durable baseline custody and same-PR adoption. Select the actual allocation mechanism and accountable owner before an issuer or wrapper whose proof depends on it; an unresolved bootstrap cycle remains a supplier gap. The first meaningful joined test follows the actual production entry through launch, the real reservation interface, sealed input, execution and collection. Substitute only genuine external boundaries: replacing an internal production role proves a component seam, not runtime readiness. Compose receiver identities, wrappers, source/tool pins, lifetimes and cleanup early; freeze one candidate for one independent existing-PR review. Preserve first failures, Unknowns, actual private successor custody outside managed/disposable roots, original receipts and the running caller pin. Missing enrollment fences board selection while independently authorized source and separately qualified Status work retain their guards; isolated cache repair preserves locks and the first content-hash failure. Reconcile current owning issues without another ledger. For non-functional prose use citation/link/archive and existing protected checks; keep unchanged advisory-format failures visible without forcing unrelated repair. Explicitly fetch unavailable immutable Git objects and verify exact bytes/hashes before claiming path absence; an unfetched or unavailable object is a retrieval gap, not a citation defect. This supersedes the earlier integration guidance without adding gates, ordinary-Git packets, review chains, runtime authority or measured savings. Source delivery does not establish publication, installed adoption or native acceptance.

Freeze one minimal execution contract before expanding components. Use one failing end-to-end test through the actual production main as the work queue; include outer input, timer and output guards. Fix its next determining failure and rerun that path before broadening tests. Separate a bounded workload through collection and cleanup from wider BAR, reboot and two-machine acceptance without dropping those promises. Keep the integrator and disjoint contributors; add work only behind stable independent interfaces. Check known typed-policy/correspondence requirements before coding and verify an actual runtime resume for stopped workers. Queued mail is not resumed execution. Consolidate questions and update owning issues at meaningful milestones, not unchanged polls. Preserve first failures and narrower earlier entrypoint evidence. These are supported improvements, not measured savings.
title: Use actual allocation and production interfaces with verified source evidence
